products.name: VEVOR 15L Upgraded Ultrasonic Cleaner, 600 W heater, 360 W ultrasonic, drain valve
specs: 360 W at 40 kHz per the title and VEVOR's Q&A (spec table says 300 W)
4.5 of 5 from 517 reviews (pooled with the 3 L and 6 L versions)
products.warranty: 1 year (VEVOR's answer on the product page); optional paid 1-, 2- or 3-year plans
products.returns: 30-day returns advertised; third-party guides say free return shipping covers only damaged, defective or wrong items
products.summary: A 15-liter heated tank with room for small-engine and motorcycle carburetors, a 600 W heater that owners say warms it far faster than the 100-300 W heaters on cheaper units, and a drain valve so you don't have to tip out dirty solution.
products.fit: Home mechanics cleaning small-engine, motorcycle or single-barrel car carbs a few times a year.
caveats: The listing gives both 360 W and 300 W of ultrasonic power. VEVOR's Q&A answer says 360 W.
One owner reports that the timer stops the ultrasonics but not the heater, so switch the heater off yourself.
Owners call it loud. One owner quieted it by adding weatherstripping to the lid.
Cleaning cycles run 30 minutes at most, so a dirty carb takes several cycles.

products.name: VEVOR 22L Ultrasonic Cleaner with Heater, Timer and Basket, 480 W
specs: 4.6 of 5 from 1,104 reviews (pooled with other sizes)
products.warranty: No length given on the product page; optional paid 1-, 2- or 3-year plans
products.returns: 30-day returns advertised; third-party guides say free return shipping covers only damaged, defective or wrong items
products.summary: The same 5.9 in depth as the 15L, but 19.7 in long with 480 W across eight transducers. It has room for a rack of motorcycle carbs or the parts of a four-barrel.
products.fit: Restorers who clean a bank of four motorcycle carbs, a disassembled four-barrel, or several carbs at once.
caveats: It is no deeper than the 15L (5.9 in), so a tall assembled four-barrel still won't sit under the fluid.
The product page lists no warranty length.
It holds 22 liters, so plan on several gallons of mixed cleaning solution for each fill.

notes: Query choice: 'best ultrasonic cleaner for carburetors'. The current top results are mostly thin AI-style roundups (foliumbiosciences, sentinelmission, ovrclock, mobupps), plus maker blogs and forum threads, and they keep naming VEVOR 15L and CREWORKS 15L/22L. Pain points from about 25 owner reports (VEVOR store reviews, Canadian Hobby Metalworkers thread, RCN tests, plus search snippets from Grassroots Motorsports, Garage Journal and Yesterday's Tractors, whose pages returned 403): slow or weak heating 8; tank too small for a carb 5; noise 4; unit failure (loose transducer, board, heater after 18-36 months of daily shop use) 4-5; temperature overshoot or inaccurate dial 3; flimsy lid or handle 2. Segments: (1) home small-engine and motorcycle carbs: VEVOR 15L Upgraded wins ($135.90, 15 L, 600 W heater, drain; owner Doggggboy measured 15 to 55 °C in about 30 min) and costs less than HF 6L ($169.99) and CREWORKS 15L ($209.99, out of stock on maker store). (2) bank of four or multiple carbs: VEVOR 22L ($174.90, 500 × 300 × 150 mm, 480 W, 8 transducers). (3) in-store buying and returns: Harbor Freight 6 Liter (4.7 of 5 from 530 reviews, 90-day warranty, 370 W total). Amazon was not used (amzcheck walled); no amazon:us records. Prices read on vevor.com, harborfreight.com and the CREWORKS store (storecheck) on 2026-11-14. vevor.com is not Shopify, so prices came from WebFetch.
